No React Native / Expo deprecated packages detected on this iteration's surface (meds.tsx uses expo-audio createAudioPlayer/setAudioModeAsync, expo-notifications DAILY trigger web-guarded via Platform.OS check).
action_items: OPTIONAL: /api/meds/reminders POST returns clean(doc) but doc has already been mutated by insert_one via doc.copy() — the reminder_id set at build time is fine, but consider excluding _id explicitly if the copy() pattern ever changes.

OPTIONAL: /api/meds/today computes 'day' with datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') — this is a UTC calendar day. A user in UTC+2 taking a 22:00 CEST med will file it against the NEXT UTC day. Consider passing user tz or letting client pass local date.
OPTIONAL: _make_pdf hard-codes Liberation Sans font paths; on non-Debian bases this would fail. Wrap the FPDF font registration in a try/except with a fallback to core PDF font.

OPTIONAL: /api/legal/tos.pdf, /legal/testament.pdf, /legal/proxy.pdf accept auth via ?token= query — this is required for browser <a href> download but the token WILL land in server access logs. Consider redacting the token param in the FastAPI/uvicorn access log formatter.
OPTIONAL: server.py is now 1959 lines — /legal, /meds, /aml, /solidarity should each be extracted into routes modules (already flagged in iteration 4).
critical_code_review_comments: meds_add validates times via re.match(r'^\d{2}:\d{2}$', t) — accepts '99:99' as valid HH:MM. Consider strict 00-23:00-59 range check. Not blocking — expo-notifications DAILY trigger would throw at schedule time, but backend accepts it.

meds_intake uses upsert on the (user_id, reminder_id, date, time) tuple with $set of taken_at — this gives idempotency for free (verified) AND updates taken_at on repeat which slightly changes semantics. If audit requires original taken_at, use $setOnInsert for taken_at + $set for a separate updated_at.
PDF endpoints return 401 without auth (verified) and _auth_pdf gracefully lifts ?token= to a Bearer header before delegating to get_current_user — correct.
meds delete cascades intakes via db.med_intakes.delete_many({reminder_id}) — good, prevents orphan intake records.
meds.tsx take() optimistically sets taken:true then calls /api/meds/intake, and on error reloads — good UX pattern for XL-touch senior UI.
meds.tsx rescheduleLocal() is Platform.OS==='web' guarded — expo-notifications DAILY trigger correctly skipped on web preview (per iteration-5 note).

BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — this key is in /app/frontend/.env, NOT /app/backend/.env, so test files load both dotenv files. FE testing pattern for auth-gated apps: use page.add_init_script("window.localStorage.setItem('gh_session_token', TOKEN)") BEFORE page.goto — plain localStorage.setItem + page.reload() proved unreliable because the initial about:blank origin doesn't persist. PDF endpoints ~2-5s each (fpdf + Liberation Sans font).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs. Two test-scaffolding issues encountered and self-corrected: (1) EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL missing from backend/.env — added a second load_dotenv() call pointing at /app/frontend/.env; (2) initial FE test failed because localStorage.setItem + page.reload() did not persist the token (about:blank origin) — switched to page.add_init_script() which injects the token on every subsequent navigation and works reliably. The (1) TestRegression assertion originally expected {accepted:true} but /api/legal/accept returns the full updated user object — corrected assertion to accept user_id / tos_accepted_version / version presence.
